content: If data is transmitted using an IPv4 socket which is bound to a local address (TcpIpAddrId) using the wildcard “ANY”, then the TcpIp shall use the IP address of the configured local address (TcpIpAddrId), which is of type IPv4 Unica st and assigned to the same EthIfCtrl, as the bound local address (TcpIpAddrId) as source IP address in the IP datagram header.
